items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Single monster concept redesign for a 2D dark fairytale Unity game. Image1 is the STRICT original Mob5 anatomy/silhouette/pose reference. Image2 is only the NEW GAME painting-style reference, not a creature anatomy reference. Preserve the original recognizable round body, exact number of limbs, wing span/leg arrangement, face orientation and attachment positions, ready for later reuse of its existing Spine rig. Repaint flat cartoon art into nuanced hand-painted storybook game art with dark ink contours, broad clear shapes, restrained textured shading, low saturation; match the illustrated mushrooms/hero in image2 without copying mushrooms. Cold gray-violet bat: worn plum-gray short velvety fur, dark desaturated violet leathery wing membranes with soft hand-painted veins, warm gray muzzle, glossy dark eyes with tiny warm highlights. Preserve the reference's asymmetrical eye expression but make both eye shapes deliberate and readable, small original ear nubs and stubby toes. Personality sleepy and wary, round airborne little forest creature. One large complete character centered on plain warm gray parchment background with generous margins and a subtle small contact/hover shadow. No scenery, no extra objects, no UI, no titles, no lettering. Dark whimsical and mildly eerie, comfortable to look at. NO photorealism, 3D render, neon, tentacles, extra eyes, exposed flesh, stitched accessories, props, floating effects or redesign of basic structure. All limbs visible and uncropped. Concept art only, not texture sheet.
